name: Easement Palm
description: Soften the pain of a fresh bruise by laying a palm over it and letting a cool flow of qi seep in.

name: Gentle Weave
description: Weave a loose net of qi across an ally's shallow wounds so each begins to close at its own pace.

name: Vein Mapping
description: Map the veins of an ally's torso with a thread of qi to find a bleed that cannot be seen.

name: Thickened Hide
description: Toughen the skin of the chest and flanks with vitality until a blade skates across it.

name: Cleansing Rill
description: Run a thin bright rill of clean qi through an ally's veins to carry off the dregs of a poison.

name: Rebounding Blow
description: Strike once and let the vitality ring back through the target's body to hit a second time from within.

name: Restoring Wave
description: Wash a broad wave of restoring qi over an ally's whole side to close scrapes and bruises at once.

name: Heart's Return
description: Cradle the head of an ally whose heart has just stopped and pour vitality into the chest until it beats again.

name: Spearing Surge
description: Spear a hard column of vitality through the target's guard and out the far side of its armour.

name: Greatheart Renewal
description: Pour a great tide of renewal over every ally in view so deep wounds close and the weary rise.

name: Spring Balm
description: Let warmth well up from the palm like a spring and flow into an ally's gash until the edges lie flat.

name: Renewed Skin
description: Lay a new thin layer of vitality over an ally's burn so the pain fades while true skin forms.

name: Quicken Limb
description: Quicken the vitality in an ally's weary limbs so each stride recovers its spring.

name: Flowing Dodge
description: Flow sideways on a bright current of vitality in the legs to be somewhere else when the blow lands.

name: Burdened Palm
description: Bring the palm down on the target's shoulder with settled weight and vitality that drives it to a knee.

name: Venom Flush
description: Flush a snake's venom from an ally's limb by driving clean qi down the vessels and out the wound.

name: Curse Lifting
description: Lift the dull weight of a minor curse from an ally's heart and limbs with a long cleansing breath.

name: Yielding Turn
description: Yield at the moment of contact and roll the force of a blow along a slick arm into empty air.

name: Stifling Touch
description: Press a hand to the target's chest and cut the flow of its qi to leave its technique half formed.

name: Springbreath
description: Breathe the first spring of vitality into the mouth of a drowned or choked ally to restore the breath.

name: Bane Veil
description: Spread a veil of living qi that dissolves a poison or a curse before it reaches an ally's flesh.

name: Twinspring Return
description: Pour both springs of vitality into a lifeless ally to bring back breath and pulse within the short window.

name: Skilled Hand
description: Lay a steady hand on an ally's side and let qi flow in to ease a stitch and quiet a bruise.

name: Soothing Wrap
description: Wrap a wounded ally's arm in bands of soothing qi that hold the wound closed and numb the pain.

name: Organ Sounding
description: Tap a thread of qi along an ally's ribs and listen to the answer of each organ beneath.

name: Flowing Strength
description: Let a smooth flow of the user's strength run through a held hand into a flagging ally.

name: Spilling Palm
description: Strike with a palm brimming with stored vitality that spills into the target on contact.

name: Toxin Unbinding
description: Unbind a toxin from the tissues of an ally and wash it out through the skin and breath.

name: Joint Reseating
description: Set a dislocated joint of an ally with a swift twist while qi cushions the strained tissue.

name: Bristling Hide
description: Raise a bristling hide of hard vitality over the shoulders that scrapes the hands of any striker.

name: Heartswell
description: Send a slow rising tide of vitality through a fallen ally's chest until the heart lifts and beats on its own.

name: Bursting Bloom
description: Burst a bloom of hard vitality outward from the body to batter every enemy standing near.

name: Vital Siphon
description: Spear the target with a hooked thread of qi and pull its vitality across to knit the user's own wounds.

name: Poised Touch
description: Touch an ally's wound with two poised fingers and send a precise pulse of qi to close it.

name: Trailing Warmth
description: Leave a trail of warmth along an ally's wound as the hand sweeps over it so the flesh follows.

name: Marrow Sounding
description: Send a pulse of qi into an ally's long bones and read the echo for cracks.

name: Gentle Barrier
description: Hold a gentle barrier of qi before a wounded ally so a thrown stone is stopped without a sound.

name: Weightless Hop
description: Hop clear of a low sweep on a lightness of vitality and land as if the ground were soft.

name: Fever Lowering
description: Quench a raging fever in an ally by pulling the heat from the core out through the palms.

name: Deep Soothing
description: Soothe the deep ache of a bone bruise in an ally with slow rolling waves of warm vitality.

name: Dizzying Jolt
description: Jolt the balance centre behind the target's ear with a pulse of qi that sets its head spinning.

name: Heartclasp
description: Clasp the heart of a fallen ally between two hands of vitality and squeeze it back to its rhythm.

name: Silkflow
description: Flow from a mending pass to a warding turn to a rousing strike in one unbroken run of motion.

name: Renewal Surge
description: Cast a surge of renewal outward from the user that closes the deep wounds of every ally it reaches.

name: Quiet Salve
description: Spread a quiet film of healing qi over a scrape to dry it and close it in a few breaths.

name: Brace Vigor
description: Brace an ally's frame with a hard surge of vitality so the ally holds a heavy load a little longer.

name: Pulse Whisper
description: Catch the faintest whisper of an ally's pulse through the fingertips even when the ally lies unmoving.

name: Pressing Blow
description: Press a heavy open-handed blow into the target's belly and release the stored vitality at the last instant.

name: Infection Draw
description: Draw the creeping infection out of an ally's wound and burn it off in the palm.

name: Pliant Guard
description: Make the guarding arm pliant with vitality so a hard blow sinks in and spreads without harm.

name: Drilling Needle
description: Drill a spinning needle of vitality into the soft gap between the target's plates.

name: Breathkeep
description: Hold a fallen ally's last breath in place with a bracing clasp of qi and breathe it back to life.

name: Lingering Warmth
description: Cast a lingering warmth over the ground so every ally who stands in it mends steadily for a while.

name: Quelling Veil
description: Draw a great veil of living qi over the group that quells poison and curse before they take hold.

name: Beat Salve
description: Rub warm qi into the chest of an ally in time with the heartbeat to ease a sore ribcage.

name: Racing Calm
description: Lay a hand on the throat of an ally with a racing heart and slow it with cool qi.

name: Steady Surge
description: Hold a steady surge of vitality in an ally's heart so the beat stays strong through a long fight.

name: Pulse Mapping
description: Map every pulse in a small crowd at once and mark which beats are failing.

name: Skimming Step
description: Skim across rough ground on springing vitality to reach a failing ally in a few strides.

name: Poison Letting
description: Open a small vent in an ally's skin and let the poison run out with a pull of qi.

name: Closing Wave
description: Send a closing wave of qi along an ally's torn flank so the wound shuts end to end.

name: Rebounding Skin
description: Let the skin rebound the force of a strike outward along the line it came.

name: Drumbeat Return
description: Drum a hard rhythm of vitality onto a still chest until the heart takes up the beat and holds it.

name: Pulse Detonation
description: Detonate the stored beat of the heart in a ring of force that hurls back all who press near.

name: Unbroken Beat
description: Cast a steady beat of vitality into a lifeless ally to hold the heart to its rhythm within the short window.

name: Rolling Warmth
description: Roll slow warmth up an ally's torn thigh from knee to hip until the muscle binds and holds.

name: Cold Draw
description: Draw the stinging cold out of an ally's frost-bitten fingers with a warm slow pull of qi.

name: Rattle Reading
description: Listen to the breath of an ally and read the hidden hurt in each catch and rattle.

name: Spirited Lift
description: Lift the spirit and strength of an ally with a bright burst of vitality to the heart.

name: Vowed Strike
description: Throw a sworn strike with the whole body behind it and vitality flaring along the arm.

name: Air Washing
description: Wash the lungs of an ally free of acrid smoke and fouled air with a long cleansing exhale.

name: Rot Burning
description: Burn the rot out of an ally's festering wound with a short hot flare of clean qi.

name: Deep Closing
description: Close a deep puncture of an ally from the bottom up in one patient layered sweep.

name: Vowshield
description: Stand over a wounded comrade and spread a hard ward of vitality that no blow may cross.

name: Gasp Reversal
description: Reverse the last gasp of a dying ally by driving vitality in as the chest falls.

name: Spiking Surge
description: Spike a thin hard surge of vitality through the target's armour and into the muscle behind.

name: Oathbound Revival
description: Pour the full oath of a healer into a lifeless comrade to call back breath and heart within the short window.

name: Tough Salve
description: Rub a tough salve of qi into an ally's cracked hands until the skin knits and the soreness leaves.

name: Gash Binding
description: Bind a gash of an ally with a wrap of woven qi that tightens as the flesh pulls together.

name: Hardy Warmth
description: Leave a hardy warmth in an ally's frame that holds off fatigue and chill through the long hours.

name: Dense Guard
description: Pack vitality dense against the forearm and chest until a heavy swing breaks upon them.

name: Dropweight Palm
description: Bring the palm down like an anvil with the weight of a thick body and a flare of vitality.

name: Blight Draw
description: Draw a spreading blight out of an ally's flesh before it can reach the heart.

name: Knot Release
description: Release the hard knots of an ally's overworked back with a spreading bloom of qi.

name: Weighty Palm
description: Drive a heavy palm into the target's chest and let a dense surge of vitality follow it in.

name: Ribcage Rousing
description: Rouse the stilled chest of a fallen ally with repeated hard pulses of qi until breath returns.

name: Draining Clamp
description: Clamp a hand about the target's wrist and sap its strength and qi flow for as long as the hold lasts.

name: Healing Tide
description: Raise a wide tide of healing qi that rolls over every ally nearby and closes their wounds.

name: Breath Balm
description: Breathe a balm of warm qi into an ally's chest to loosen a tight cough and ease the lungs.

name: Lung Listening
description: Rest an ear against an ally's back and listen through qi to the wet rattle of a hurt lung.

name: Renewed Breath
description: Give a winded ally a renewed breath of vitality so the legs and lungs find a second effort.

name: Buoyant Foot
description: Lighten the feet with vitality and glide over loose ground without sinking or slowing.

name: Bracing Skin
description: Brace the skin along the ribs with vitality against a hard blow and a rattling cough.

name: Dust Clearing
description: Clear the fine grit and dust from an ally's lungs with a rhythmic push of qi.

name: Chest Venting
description: Release the pressure of blood or air trapped in an ally's chest with a sharp thumb of qi.

name: Hooked Needle
description: Hook a needle of vitality into a seam of the target's guard and wrench it open.

name: Rescue Breath
description: Breathe the user's own vitality into a lifeless ally in long rescuing breaths until the chest answers.

name: Slipping Veil
description: Draw a slick veil of vitality across the body so blows slip off along its surface.

name: Recall Surge
description: Cast a recall surge over a lifeless comrade to haul the breath and heartbeat back inside the short window.

name: Open Salve
description: Smooth an open salve of qi across a weathered cut and watch the edges seal in the air.

name: Wound Wrap
description: Wrap a bleeding limb of an ally in a sleeve of qi that clots and closes it.

name: Hurt Sensing
description: Sense the ache in the bodies about the user and mark who hides an injury.

name: Battering Palm
description: Batter the target's guard with three palm strikes that each add another layer of vitality.

name: Purge Touch
description: Purge a foul substance from an ally's blood with one firm clasp and a surge of clean qi.

name: Winding Jolt
description: Send a winding jolt up the target's arm to snarl its qi before it can gather.

name: Cloak Ward
description: Draw a cloak of vitality about a wounded ally that turns aside cuts and keeps the cold out.

name: Pulse Restoral
description: Restore a lost pulse in an ally by pressing a rhythm of qi into the wrist and chest together.

name: Shockwave Bloom
description: Open a bloom of shock from the palms that knocks back everything near and stuns the weak.

name: Needling Surge
description: Fire a rain of vitality needles that stitch through the target's guard and leave it faint.

name: Broad Warmth
description: Spread broad warmth across an ally's back to ease a day's bruises and strains.

name: Painlifter
description: Lift the sharp pain out of an ally's wound with a cool tug of qi at its centre.

name: Stoutening
description: Stoutening an ally's frame with a steady stream of vitality so heavy blows and weight are borne better.

name: Reserve Gauge
description: Gauge how much vitality an ally has left in reserve with a brief touch to the wrist.

name: Firm Ward
description: Set a firm ward of vitality before the chest that holds against a hard thrust.

name: Corruption Rinse
description: Rinse corruption from an ally's veins with repeated cool waves of clean qi.

name: Blight Wash
description: Wash the blight of a withering curse out of an ally's skin and joints.

name: Layered Closing
description: Close a deep gash of an ally in layers from muscle to skin with patient qi.

name: Cracking Palm
description: Crack the palm against the target's guard so vitality shakes the bones of the arm beneath.

name: Chestwake
description: Wake the stopped chest of an ally with a deep press and a long surge of vitality.

name: Whirlflow
description: Spin from a healing sweep over an ally into a blow at the foe in a single turning motion.

name: Lifebreath Return
description: Return the lifebreath to a fallen ally with a great calling surge inside the short window.

name: Tender Rub
description: Rub a tender circle of warm qi into an ally's strained calf until the knot gives way.

name: Cooling Knit
description: Knit a hot inflamed cut with cooling qi that draws the swelling down as it closes.

name: Vitality Gift
description: Give a portion of the user's vitality to a worn ally so the ally recovers a full measure of strength.

name: Piston Palm
description: Shoot the palm forward like a piston with vitality packed behind it to burst the target's guard.

name: Hare Step
description: Bound away from a grab in a hare's quick zig of vitality-driven steps.

name: Sting Drawing
description: Draw a sting or spine and its venom out of an ally's flesh with a gentle suction of qi.

name: Layering Warmth
description: Layer warmth over an ally's wound in thin sheets until deep and surface pain both melt.

name: Veering Skin
description: Veer the force of a blow off the body by letting the skin ripple and slide.

name: Callback
description: Call back a fallen ally across a heartbeat of silence with a long pull of vitality into the chest.

name: Surge Ring
description: Release a ring of raw vitality that shoves back every foe within the user's reach.

name: Broad Renewal
description: Cast a broad renewal across the battle line so deep wounds in every ally begin to close at once.
